body:
Residual of #867 (`fix/867-nitrogen`); red-team r1 confirmed R1-R5, and R6 was found while drafting.

Tier: **B** (country config).
- `nitrogen_kg(Guinea-Bissau)` has 5,534 rows, 0 matched and 0 plots.
- The inorganic labels, all with a quantity, are 334 rows:
  - `Adubos inorgânicos - ureia` (190);
  - `Adubos inorgânicos - fosfatos` (57);
  - `Adubos inorgânicos - NPK/Fórmula única` (46);
  - `DAP e outros adubos inorgânicos` (41).
- The organic labels `Adubos orgânicos - estrume animal` (365) and `- lixo doméstico` (150) are refused and named. That is correct per the ruling.
- Fix: harmonise `input` country-side onto the canonical labels (`Urea`, the phosphate class, `NPK`). `DAP e outros…` is a mixed bucket and should stay unmatched, or go to `Other Fertilizer` with that decision written down.
- Source: `slurm_logs/gh867_nitrogen/census_after.json`. Read `Guinea-Bissau/_/CONTENTS.org` first.
title: Guinea-Bissau `nitrogen_kg` returns 0 rows — its four Portuguese inorganic labels are keyed to nothing
